prompt:
You are a robot that helps people at home. Below is the record observed so far.

[Observation record]
{record}

[Task]
What state of mind did this user have at the moment the robot acted?
- A state of mind means what the user wants, or why they would act a certain way.
- Answer in one sentence.

results.title: 참으려다 마심
results.hidden: 마시고 싶지만 탄산을 줄이려고 참으려 했다
results.answer: The user likely did not want the canned drink because they were trying to cut out soda, even though they later drank it.

results.title: 못 봤을 뿐
results.answer: The user was focused on playing the game and likely wanted to continue without interruption.

results.title: 자리가 문제
results.hidden: 커피는 원하지만 노트북 옆에 두면 쏟을까 봐 싫다
results.answer: The user likely wanted to read their email without a cup of coffee crowding the space next to the keyboard.

results.title: 짜증의 대상
results.answer: The user was likely upset by the text message and wanted to deal with it, rather than receive a soda.

results.title: 반만 맞음
results.hidden: 큰 불은 꺼도 되지만, 아직 자지 않고 책을 읽으려 한다
results.answer: The user likely wanted to relax and read in bed with softer lighting.

results.title: 너무 일찍 치움
results.hidden: 치우는 건 좋지만, 잠깐 자리를 비운 것이지 다 먹은 게 아니었다
results.answer: The user intended to return and finish the snacks after using the bathroom.

results.title: 친구에게 밀어 줌
results.hidden: 자기는 물이 있어서 괜찮고, 기침하는 친구가 마시길 바랐다
results.answer: The user likely wanted their coughing friend to have a drink, while they used their own water bottle.

results.title: 커튼이 10분 이름
results.answer: The user likely wanted to keep sleeping and was reluctant to wake up.

results.title: 고맙지만 더움
results.hidden: 챙겨 준 마음은 고맙지만, 더워서 담요는 필요 없다
results.answer: The user likely wanted to rest or doze off, but was feeling warm rather than needing a blanket.

results.title: 약 먹을 물
results.hidden: 목이 말라서가 아니라 약을 먹으려고 물이 필요했다
results.answer: The user likely wanted water to help swallow a pill.

results.title: 스탠드가 눈부심
results.hidden: 켜 준 건 좋지만, 너무 밝고 빛이 눈에 바로 왔다
results.answer: The user likely wanted enough light to read comfortably, but not the bright light shining directly into their eyes.

results.title: 이미 물이 있음
results.hidden: 물은 원하지만, 마시던 물병이 이미 있었다
results.answer: The user likely wanted to continue taking notes and was not ready for a new water bottle, since they still had water in the one on the desk.

results.title: 휴지에 웃음
results.answer: The user was emotionally moved by the movie and likely wanted to wipe away their tears.

results.title: 룸메이트가 자는 중
results.hidden: 평소엔 불 켜기가 좋지만, 지금은 룸메이트가 자고 있다
results.answer: The user wanted to get into bed quietly without disturbing their roommate.

results.title: 커피가 씀
results.answer: The user likely wanted coffee to drink while working, preferably sweetened.
